newsitem.title: UK: Tanker hits pier at Ventspils oil port.
newsitem.headline: Tanker hits pier at Ventspils oil port.

text.p: A crude oil tanker collided with a pier at the Baltic port of Ventspils, Lloyds Shiping Intelligence said on Thursday.
Oil exports are not thought to have been affected.
"I've not heard anything, so it's probably not too important," a London representive of the port said.
The 111,777 dwt Progress hit the end of pier number one earlier today as it was entering the port, Lloyds said. The tanker was not thought to be carrying a cargo.
The pier's owners, Ventbunker, say the damage amounts to about $500,000, but there were no details of any damage to the Progress.
The vessel's operators could not be contacted.
